headline: GTA+
subtitle: This Month’s Benefits
content:
In addition to the recurring monthly GTA$500,000 deposited directly into your Maze Bank account, GTA+ Members who've signed up for this month (August 13–September 9) will also receive:

— The new Gallivanter Warden (SUV)
— 60% off the Darnell Bros Garment Factory
— The Pink SN x PRB Bomber Zipped and PRB Tee and PRB Shorts
— 2X GTA$ and RP on all FIB Files
— And more

Membership automatically renews monthly, cancel anytime. Visit rsg.ms/gtaplus for more info.
